decision.why: Three weeks in, pins tripled (39 -> 107) but impressions PER PIN stayed flat (1.4 -> 2.2 -> 2.0), saves are 0 every week and outbound clicks have been stuck at 2 since 08-25. Saves are the signal Pinterest distributes on, so a fourth week of zero is the number that decides.
readInThisOrder: 1. saves. Everything else follows from it.
2. impressions per pin (impressions / pins), NOT total impressions - total grows just because we pin more.

thresholds.distributionStarting: saves > 0 AND impressions/pin above 2.5 - Pinterest has begun showing the pins. Change nothing about the pins; turn on the learning loop (feed the per-pin results back into which posts get pinned) and re-read in four more weeks.
thresholds.pinIsNotEarningIt: saves still 0 AND impressions/pin still near 2 - the pin itself is not earning distribution. Two changes, both named in advance: (a) write descriptions for Pinterest SEARCH rather than reusing the Google meta description, leading with what we alone can say (which hours are quiet); (b) consolidate the ~20 thin country boards into a few thick topical ones. Then re-measure four weeks before judging again.
thresholds.overPinning: impressions/pin FALLING while pin count rises - stop the 2->8/day ramp where it is and hold. More pins into a channel that is not distributing them is the wrong direction.
thresholds.seenButNotClicked: impressions rising, saves > 0, but outbound clicks still 2 - the image and title are not earning the click. That is a creative problem, not a volume one; rework the pin composition before touching anything else.

decision.doNotDoYet: Do not change pin copy or board structure before 09-14. The sample is too thin to measure a change against, and changing it now would destroy the only baseline we have.
decision.keepOrKill: The keep-or-kill decision for Pinterest as a channel stays where it was set: early November, judged on this same weekly ledger.
decision.judgedNote: Week 4 (2026-09-14, window 08-15..09-14): 135 pins, 426 impressions = 3.16/pin, saves 0, outbound clicks 1. Series per pin 1.4 -> 2.2 -> 2.0 -> 3.2. Read in order: (1) saves are 0 for the fourth week, so distributionStarting and seenButNotClicked are out (both need saves > 0). (2) impressions/pin ROSE to 3.2, so overPinning is out (needs it falling) and pinIsNotEarningIt is not met as written (needs it still near 2). The per-pin rise is not a window artifact: this window dropped 08-08..08-14, so if anything it undercounts; 111 of 135 pins now have impressions (13 of 39 on 08-25). (3) outbound clicks 2 -> 1. None of the four pre-registered branches fired, so none of their actions were taken: no copy rewrite, no board consolidation, no learning loop, ramp not stopped. Nothing changed pin copy or boards between 09-10 and 09-14 (only change near the window: 0eeb95e31 on 09-07, before registration, fixed pin QUEUE ORDER, not copy), so the baseline is clean. Held as-is; owner decides whether saves-still-0 alone should trigger (a)+(b). Keep-or-kill stays early November.
decision.executedNote: Owner handed the call back ("니가 제대로 판단해서 합리적으로 결정하고 실행해", 2026-09-16). Read in the pre-registered order: saves 0 for a fourth week is the number that decides, and the branch written for it is pinIsNotEarningIt. Its literal wording said "impressions/pin still near 2" and the figure rose to 3.2 — but 3.2 impressions per pin is still no distribution, and the reason the branch exists (four weeks, 135 pins, nobody saved one) is met exactly. EXECUTED (a): pin descriptions are now written for Pinterest search — the quiet window first, then place, rating and the planner checklist, then search-word hashtags (lib/pin-description.mjs). NOT executed (b) board consolidation, deliberately: running both at once makes the four-week re-measure unreadable, and moving 135 live pins between boards is an irreversible change to the owner's public account. If saves are still 0 on 2026-10-14, (b) runs then with (a) already known.

cohort.why: First pin written with the hook ladder. Pins made before it keep their old wording forever, so weekly rows carry before/after from here on and the re-measure reads `after` only.

followUp: 2026-09-21: audited what change (a) actually shipped. The 09-16 rewrite had ONE hook — the quiet window — and it resolved on 10 of the 40 newest pins, so three pins in four still opened with the venue name. Change (a) had reached a quarter of the pins, and a 10-14 re-measure would have judged a change that was barely made.

2026-09-21: hook is a ladder now (quiet hours -> closed days -> uniform opening hours -> the guide quickAnswer). Coverage across the 1,475 queued posts: 93% (quiet 39, answer 29, hours 15, closed 11), up from 25%. Money amounts and perishable sentences are refused. The closing line now reads the guide body instead of promising a getting-there passage 40% of guides do not have.

2026-09-21: re-measure moved 10-14 -> 10-19, four weeks after the wording that is actually live. Judge `after` (the cohort from florence-boboli-gardens on), not the totals: 241 pins carry the old wording and will drown the signal.

Change (b), board consolidation, is STILL not done. Two wording changes in one month is already one experiment too many, and consolidating boards moves pins that are the only baseline we have. It waits for the 10-19 read.
